'''Tidros''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Champala/Legends|Champala]].<ref name="LECG" /> The city contained a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] which, unlike the rest of the city, reached above the surface of Champala's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]].<ref name="Lead by Example">''[[Lead by Example]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tidros was first mentioned in the ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'', a roleplaying game sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2009]].<ref name="LECG" />
